disabled.description: Makes an editable rating unavailable and excludes it from form submission.

icon-name.description: Lucide icon name. Import custom names before mounting. Unavailable names use star.

label.description: Visible question in input mode and accessible context in read-only mode. Always supply it.

max.description: Highest score and number of glyphs. Use a whole number from 1 to 10.

name.description: Form field name for a selected editable score.

option-label.description: Accessible name pattern for the other choices. Use {value} for the choice.

option-singular-label.description: Accessible name pattern for the one-star choice. Use {value} for the choice.

precision.description: Choose 1 for whole steps or 0.5 for half steps. Other inputs use whole steps.

rated-label.description: Accessible name pattern for the read-only image. Use {value} and {max} for the scores.

readonly.description: Displays a score without editing or submitting it.

required.description: Requires an editable score before the form can be submitted.

required-message.description: Validation message for an unanswered required rating.

score-label.description: Visible score pattern in input mode. Use {value} and {max} for the scores.

value.description:
Current score. Zero means unanswered in input mode. Editable scores use
the nearest allowed step. Read-only scores retain their decimal precision.

--ki-density-target-min.description: The smallest pointer target any density may produce: 24 x 24 CSS px by default and in compact (WCAG 2.5.8 AA), 44 x 44 in touch (WCAG 2.5.5). It floors a shrinking control but never lifts what a control paints: a control painted smaller extends its target to it, invisibly; rows and tabs grow to it (spec 045 A1).

--ki-focus-ring-color.description: Colour of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws: 3:1 or more against the page in every theme and scheme.

--ki-focus-ring-width.description: Thickness of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws (its outline). One token instead of one per component, so a mode or a theme changes every ring at once.

--ki-rating-disabled-fg.description: Glyph ink while the rating is unavailable.

--ki-rating-gap.description: Space between rating glyphs or targets.

--ki-rating-hover-backdrop-filter.description: Complete backdrop filter for the hovered choice.

--ki-rating-hover-bg.description: Surface of the choice under the pointer.

--ki-rating-hover-bg-image.description: Optional image over the hovered choice surface.

--ki-rating-label-gap.description: Space between the question and scale.

--ki-rating-score-gap.description: Space between the glyphs and visible score.

--ki-typography-family-body.description: semantic font family for typography family body.

--ki-typography-line-height-body-1.description: semantic dimension for typography line height body 1.

--ki-typography-size-body-1.description: semantic dimension for typography size body 1.

--ki-typography-weight-body-medium.description: semantic font weight for typography weight body medium.

component.description: Displays a score or collects one choice on a small rating scale.

ki-change.description: Fires once when a person changes the selection. The detail contains the numeric value.

choice.description: Native radio target for one selectable score.

glyph.description: Decorative artwork for one rating step.

label.description: Visible question above the editable scale.

scale.description: Read-only score image or editable radio group.
